author: PokerFace
body:
Hello. An idea I have is for each team (competitive or just for fun) to be able to select a primary country for their team. That way, when you organize a match between two teams, you can have a suitable time for the match as long as there are Event Staff available.

For example, let's say...
Cacalmarin: Australia
Power Puff:  United States (East Coast)

Basically, all you would have to do is use a timetable to see the most suitable time.
If it was 10am in Australia, then it would be 6pm somewhere in the U.S. This is definitely a great time for both teams!

The only downfall I see is that the Event Staff would have to be flexible, and at least 1 official has to be on at any time within 24 hours. The separation of the matches however is good in the sense that people could watch more than one stream instead of picking one match to watch out of four matches that are going on at the same time. I'm pretty sure that this is how it works in other competitive game scenes such as CS:GO. I'm pretty sure Fnatic won't play Cloud9 at 2am for a LAN qualifier when there are many other suitable times available.

If the feature isn't added to the website, when you have teams register, you should ask them to list their country if they want to have a preference on the time of their matches.

Anyways, comment below.
